title: Diamond Agent: Agentic Control of Federated HPC Resources as a Service
abstract: arXiv:2609.06181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficiently aggregating and orchestrating computing power across heterogeneous clusters for HPC workflows faces four practical challenges: preserving workflow context across independently administered clusters, moving large datasets between sites, reasoning about site-specific environments and scheduler policies, and exploiting live queue and resource states for efficient task scheduling. To this end, we design Diamond Agent, an agentic system that enables intelligent execution of HPC workflows across heterogeneous clusters with typed skills as the interface. Diamond Agent provides an agent-facing workspace and skills that unify cross-site resource discovery, resource specification, data movement, task execution, and result retrieval. A centralized Diamond Agent instance can operate multiple supercomputers without being deployed separately on each login node. translated_title: Diamond Agent：以智能体方式实现联邦式HPC资源的即服务控制
translated_abstract: 高效地聚合与编排跨异构集群的计算能力以支持HPC工作流，面临四个实际挑战：在独立管理的集群之间保持工作流上下文、在站点之间迁移大规模数据集、理解特定站点的环境与调度器策略、以及利用实时队列和资源状态实现高效的任务调度。为此，我们设计了Diamond Agent——一个以类型化技能为接口的智能体系统，能够在异构集群上智能化地执行HPC工作流。Diamond Agent提供了面向智能体的工作区和技能集，统一了跨站点的资源发现、资源规约、数据移动、任务执行和结果检索。一个集中部署的Diamond Agent实例即可操作多台超级计算机，无需在每个登录节点上单独部署。Diamond Agent将高层智能体动作转换为有效的站点特定执行命令
tldr: Diamond Agent是一个智能体系统，通过类型化技能接口统一跨站点资源发现、数据移动、任务执行与结果检索，实现对联邦异构HPC超级计算资源的集中式智能编排与控制。
en_tdlr: Diamond Agent is an agentic system that unifies cross-site resource discovery, data movement, task execution, and result retrieval through typed skills, enabling centralized, intelligent orchestration of federated heterogeneous HPC resources as a service.
